scientific_question: At the same 512-column component cap and identical finite-pool MIP settings, does preserving every positive final child-RMP trip set improve the 32-duty parent solution versus the first longest-route selector?
interpretation: This campaign isolates pool selection while preserving each child integer witness and fractional RMP witness. It does not produce a parent pricing certificate or full-model LP bound. All 46 MIPs are treatment comparisons on one parent instance.
